methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.subtitle: A validated, transparent dual-model pipeline.

pipeline.title: Forecasting pipeline
pipeline.text: Calm regime (< 10 m/s): XGBoost model trained directly on calm readings. Strong regime (≥ 10 m/s): a GRU network (24h sequence) corrected by a second XGBoost model trained on residuals. Regime is determined hour by hour with a hysteresis band (9.5–10.5 m/s) to avoid erratic switching.

limits.title: Limits, honestly
limits.text: On very calm sites, relative error (MAPE) mechanically increases because true wind speed is close to zero — an irreducible noise floor exists. For an untested site, the forecast remains indicative: the confidence index accounts for this and phrases it cautiously.

methodology.mapeNote: The MAPE shown is computed point-by-point on readings > 1 m/s (standard measure). It should not be confused with a simplified relative error (MAE / average speed), which would give a different figure.
